decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]

decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]

decision.references: https://www.adecec.net/infcor/ (INFCOR, ADECEC), entry "ragliu / raglia" (FR rail; EN rail, railroad; DEF "Trave di metallu chì serve di guida à un mobile: e raglie di a strada ferrata"); local Vikipedia dump cowiki-latest (corsican_words.py resources), binariu 5 = binary ("codici binariu", "ritimu binariu"); round 3: https://adecec.net/data/new_lessichi/html/chaudronnerie.html "rail (nm) : raglia (nf)"; https://cf-corse.corsica/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/lexique.pdf printed page 101 (ragliu with masculine adjectives, raglie with feminine plural agreement)

round3.references: (1) ADECEC, La chaudronnerie, https://adecec.net/data/new_lessichi/html/chaudronnerie.html, entry "rail (nm) : raglia (nf)" (page fetched once, 2026-10-18); (2) Chemins de fer de la Corse, Lexique, https://cf-corse.corsica/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/lexique.pdf, printed page 101 (PDF page 101, viewed as an image): "rail extérieur rectiligne : ragliu esterioru dirittu", "rail intérieur courbe : ragliu interiore curbu", "rail neuf-déformé-usé-cassé-soudé : ragliu novu-sfurmatu-frustu-rottu-saldatu", "rail visqueux : ragliu viscosu", "rail-route : ragliustradone", "rails raccordés : raglie appicciate-aghjunte", "rails (poser des) : mette-pone e raglie", "rails de raccord : raglie d'abboccu-di ghjunta", "rails de voie courante : raglie di strada currente", "rails dits « gras » : raglie unte"; page 127: "voie métrique-voie ferrée : strada metrica-strada ferrata"; (3) INFCOR entry "ragliu raglia" (n.m., FR rail, EN rail, railroad, VAR raglia, DEF "... e raglie di a strada ferrata"), read from the cache of the 2026-10-18 scripted lookups (to re-consult by hand)
round3.uncertainty: low for the noun; Powered/Detector/Activator are compounds built for the game (alimentatu, rilevatore, attivatore not in the railway lexicon); whether a speaker prefers raglia (f.) in the singular is open

decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]

[Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]

decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]
decision.previous: Binariu | Binariu alimentatu | Binariu attivatore | Binariu rilevatore

decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]

decision.justification: Round 3 (corrected): ragliu is the attested railway term (INFCOR ragliu n.m.; Chemins de fer de la Corse lexicon p. 101; ADECEC chaudronnerie gives the feminine singular raglia). It also avoids using one word for "binary" (keypad key) and "rail" in the same file. That binariu means "binary" does not prove it cannot mean a rail (polysemy, cf. Italian binario): Binariu is not shown wrong, Ragliu is preferred. Masculine singular: Ragliu alimentatu, Ragliu rilevatore, Ragliu attivatore (as "ragliu interiore curbu"); plural raglie is feminine. Details: round3.tsv T01. [Round 1 wording: "Binariu is read as binary in Corsican texts and the same file uses it for the binary keypad key; ragliu is the attested rail."]
